summary: 40 judged: 36 PASS, 4 FAIL (90%). Every evidence quote was found on the page it claims; none fabricated. The failures share one pattern: the readers searched the source body for the target's exact title and stopped there, missing a reason that lives under another name or on the hub's side. Donella Meadows is named in FOUR PILLARS' own worked crossing; Trickster names the pillars through a piped alias, and the 'hub already holds this link' claim is false; The Practice Rediscovers Its Philosophy states the pillar thesis in lowercase through the Hyperdimensional Prism. The fourth (Martin Buber) is the reverse error: a question in a forward vector was promoted to a mirrors claim. The cuts of bare connects-to links on ceremonies, makers and person pages are sound.
